description.value: A 77-room Best Western Plus property situated in Langley City roughly 45 minutes east of downtown Vancouver, surrounded by farmland and recreational opportunities. The hotel has received the chain's 'Best of the Best' award for six consecutive years and offers an indoor heated pool, hot tub, and fitness centre. Touring cyclists will find onsite coin laundry, complimentary hot breakfast, and an adjacent full-service restaurant and lounge convenient after a long day in the saddle.

address.value: 5978 Glover Rd, Langley City, BC V3A 4H9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM name, phone, and address. Amenities are listed across multiple subpages; coin laundry, free Wi-Fi, and an on-site restaurant (Ricky's Country Restaurant & Lounge) are explicitly confirmed. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, e-bike charging, or any cycling-specific services anywhere on the site, so those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM address field omits postal code; website gives full address as 5978 Glover Rd, Langley City, BC V3A 4H9 — minor discrepancy, not a concern for inclusion.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating hotel with a live booking site and confirmed contact details; straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists as overnight accommodation.
